_meta.project: Rasel Travel — Dynamic Visa Intake Form
_meta.category_definition: student = study in destination; business = business visit (meetings/conference/trade, no local employment); employee = employment/work in destination (employer-sponsored).
_meta.selection_basis: Top 50 destinations for Bangladeshi travellers by combined labour migration (Gulf + SE Asia work routes), student mobility (US/UK/Canada/Australia/EU/Japan/Korea/China), business and visit travel. A curated working list for Rasel Travel's market, not an official statistical ranking.
official_basis: Schengen states: Harmonised Application Form, Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 (Visa Code) Annex I — one official form for all Schengen short-stay (business) applications; study/work use each state's National Type-D form, named per country.

USA: DS-160 Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application (CEAC, ceac.state.gov) — sections: Personal 1-2, Address & Phone, Passport, Travel, Travel Companions, Previous US Travel, US Contact, Family, Work/Education/Training, Security, Photo.
UK: GOV.UK online application (UKVI) — CAS for Student, CoS for Skilled Worker, Standard Visitor for business.
Canada: IRCC forms — Study Permit IMM 1294 + checklist IMM 5483, Visitor/Business IMM 5257, Work Permit IMM 1295, Family Information IMM 5645 (all routes).
Australia: Department of Home Affairs ImmiAccount — Student 500 (CoE + OSHC), Visitor 600 Business Visitor stream, Skills in Demand 482 (employer nomination).
China: COVA form + X1/X2 (student, JW202/JW201), M (business), Z (work + Foreigner's Work Permit notification).
All other countries: field/document structure follows the national immigration/MFA visa application form and sponsor system named in official_application_system for that country.
_meta.deliberately_excluded: Visa fees, minimum bank balances, photo dimensions and processing times are NOT in this file. They change by embassy notice and differ per mission; stamp them per country from the official portal before showing them to clients.
_meta.verification_status: Field and document NAMES follow the official forms/systems above. Country-level checklists must still be stamped with source_url + last_verified_at (see blueprint SOP) before client-live use — rules change.
_meta.how_to_use: Render dynamically: country -> categories[student|business|employee] -> application_fields (group by `section`) + required_documents (upload fields, respect `required:false` = conditional/optional).
_meta.contains: All 50 countries from v1.0 (unchanged, ranks 1-50) + 50 additional famous destinations (ranks 51-100).
